chinese: 你好，彼得和海伦！这是我的爷爷。
english: Hello Peter and Helen This is my grandpa

chinese: 你好，傅先生。很高兴见到您！
english: Hello Mr Fu Nice to meet you

chinese: 我也很高兴见到你们。欢迎来我家。让我带你们参观一下。
english: Nice to meet you too Welcome to my house Let me show you around

chinese: 谢谢。哦，那是什么，傅先生？那是一只鹅吗？
english: Thank you Oh what's that Mr Fu Is that a goose
No it isn't It's a duck

chinese: 傅先生，那些是什么植物？它们是土豆植物吗？
english: Mr Fu what are those plants Are they potato plants

chinese: 不，彼得，它们不是。它们是胡萝卜植物。
english: No Peter they aren't They're carrot plants

chinese: 这些植物呢？它们是番茄植物吗？
english: What about these plants Are they tomato plants

chinese: 这是什么种类的树？它是一棵苹果树。
english: What kind of tree is this It's an apple tree

chinese: 您有多少棵苹果树？只有两棵。
english: How many apple trees do you have Only two

chinese: 看看那些兔子。它们真可爱！您有多少只兔子？
english: Look at those rabbits They're cute How many rabbits do you have

chinese: 我有12只兔子。8只是白色的，4只是黑色的。
english: I have 12 rabbits Eight are white and four are black
